notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two drawers and the two separate door leaves of the upper cabinet. The right upper-cabinet door's closing midpoint is approximate because both door closures occur within the short interval between frames 552 and 560.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact galley kitchen, then opens and closes a food-storage drawer, separately opens and closes both door leaves of the cabinet above the stove, and finally opens and closes a utensil-and-linen drawer.
